description: At the beginning of the seminar, Sahibzada Muhammad Saeed Bhorvi, founder of Khair Publications, addressed the gathering and highlighted the objectives of the seminar and the profound significance of its theme.

On this occasion, Allama Sahibzada Muhammad Masoom Bhorvi, along with distinguished religious scholars, academics, and intellectuals, participated as special guests. The speakers shared their comprehensive perspectives on the intellectual and ideological background of the creation of Pakistan and the spiritual contributions of Sufi saints in the subcontinent.
